The '''Ansuroer sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was a subsector of [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Ansuroer included [[Lijuter]], home of the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Species/Legends|species]], in the [[Reibrin system/Legends|Reibrin system]].
